text: Objectives: This program trains students with principles of economic theories, basic theories of international economy and trade. They are also required to master basic knowledge and skills of international trade, international economy and trade regulations, economic policies in the different countries. After graduating, students are expected to have the ability to work on management, investigation, research, overseas-funded enterprises, and governmental institutions. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Economics Degree Main Courses: Political Economics, Micro-Economics, Macro-Economics, World Economy, Calculative Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Basic Course of Computer, International Trade, Practical Import and Export, Theory and Policy of WTO, International Market Marketing, Economics, International Finance, International Business Law, Monetary and Banking, E-Commerce, Network Technique, and English Course for International Trade etc.
